rules.sentence: In suspected cases of chronic hyperplastic candidiasis, prescribing systemic antifungal treatment for seven days before taking a biopsy has been shown to help identify true dysplasia rather than dysplasia caused by the presence of Candida.[12]
Debridement, chlorhexidine mouthwash, and ensuring patients receive appropriate antiretroviral treatment are included in the management of linear gingival erythema in addition to antifungal therapy.
